identity.name: Santos de Cartier

case.bezel: steel bezel with exposed screws (signature Santos design)

identity.one_liner: The large steel Santos from Cartier's 2018 relaunch, built around a tool-free bracelet swap system and the brand's own automatic caliber.

narrative.story: Cartier built the original Santos in 1904 for the aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont, who wanted to check the time without letting go of the controls — usually cited as one of the first men's wristwatches designed as such rather than adapted from a pocket watch. Cartier relaunched the Santos de Cartier in 2018 with a redesigned case, exposed bezel screws referencing the original, and a bracelet that swaps between steel and leather without tools, using the brand's own QuickSwitch and SmartLink systems.
narrative.collector_notes: The QuickSwitch strap and SmartLink bracelet-sizing system are specific to this 2018-generation case; older Santos references and the smaller Santos-Dumont line do not share these exact parts.
